restlet.name: SUST - Seed Sustana Demo (RESTlet)
restlet.description: Token-Based-Auth REST endpoint that runs the full Sustana demo seed programmatically (SUST_SL_SeedSustanaDemo.runSeedAll) and returns a JSON summary. Idempotent; re-running updates rather than duplicates. Used to insert/refresh demo data headlessly without the Suitelet UI.
